SELECT r.IDENTITY_PROPERTY AS "IDENTITY_PROPERTY", r.INDEX_NAME AS "INDEX_NAME", r.INDEX_DESCR AS "INDEX_DESCR", REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.INDEX_DIMNSN,'1','国库'),'2','地区'),'3','核算主体'),',','，') AS "INDEX_DIMNSN_DSCR", REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.INDEX_PERIOD,'1','日指标'),'2','月指标'),'3','季指标'),'4','年指标') AS "INDEX_PERIOD_DSCR", CASE WHEN r.INDEX_TYPE ='0' THEN '数值' WHEN r.INDEX_TYPE ='1' THEN '比率' END AS "INDEX_TYPE_DSCR", COALESCE(r.INDEX_DETAILS, '') AS "INDEX_DETAILS" FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation r WHERE 1=1 and r.PARENT_ID is not NULL
AND r.PERSONAL_FLAG = #{params.personalFlag}
AND r.INDEX_DIMNSN LIKE '%${params.dimensionFlag}%'
AND r.INDEX_PERIOD LIKE '%${params.periodFlag}%'
AND r.INDEX_NAME LIKE '%${params.name}%'
ORDER BY r.add_date,r.IDENTITY_PROPERTY
SELECT * FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a WHERE a.INDEX_ID = #{params.INDEX_ID}

#{indexId}
